name: Hashimoto Keigo
source: A promising young talent headhunted by a major corporation. Not only gifted at work but also above average in looks. Sociable and full of conversation topics – the perfect type. However, he harbors deep ambitions, always looking for a chance to climb the ladder. Fundamentally distrusts others.
